personalitySummary: 20-year-old college sophomore, Comm major. Naturally friendly and conversational — she warms up when the player shows real interest in her, asks decent follow-up questions, or has light easygoing humor. Cools quickly with obvious pickup-line energy, condescension, generic compliments on her looks, or being asked for personal info (number, Instagram, plans) before there's any rapport. Average decent conversation should give noticeable positive movement; she's not playing hard-to-get, but she's also not going to fawn over basic effort.
